notes.title: DOLPHINVERSE Update
notes.notes:
Thanks for all of the support and feedback! I have been working to improve the original game and to add new areas and features. Here are some of the changes in this update:

New Features

DOLPHINVERSE dance/arcade area to access new content
Tunnel Force Vortex game
Sunsetあの日 experience
Custom splash screen
Dark Explorer song and teaser
New teleportation system in DOLPHINVERSE and Sunsetあの日
 New Single by Hits Up:  HERE
Lower price



Improvements

Extra dolphins button in Dolphin Defense to bypass difficult areas, try more content, and make more accessible to seated/standing/restricted players
Labels on controls for balls, teleport, and interact
Ability to interact with Julius on the pedestal to advance the debrief messages
Fix teleport collider bug when coming back from the results page
More clear objectives in Field Training, Chocolate Mountain, Stomp the Ground, and Sorting
Easier difficulty curve in Sorting, Here We Go (Pepper), and Boss (Takeru)
Lower score thresholds on many zones
Updated lighting in most areas
Updated file structure
New icons and logos
New prompts to help players save progress


I hope you enjoy this update! I'm planning on adding more areas soon ...
